error.meaning: --input cannot be read or framed, or a document fails the fragment schema

reasons.meaning: The file --input names cannot be read
reasons.fix: Check the path; it is relative to the working directory

reasons.meaning: The --input value is not JSON; a shell that removed the quotes around an inline document is the usual cause
reasons.fix: Quote the whole document in single quotes, or pass it on stdin with --input -

reasons.meaning: A document key is not an option of the command
reasons.fix: Use the keys the command's input schema lists: acme schema <COMMAND> --json

reasons.meaning: A document value has the wrong type or is outside its set
